rollback_false_negative.finding: Transaction.Abort restored entity/PID/geometry/style/extents exactly, but create-abort could leave DBMOD=1 so the old document fingerprint changed solely through saved=false.
rollback_false_negative.resolution: Introduce document fingerprint schema v2. Keep saved/DBMOD observable in SemanticSnapshot but exclude it from semantic document_fp. Geometry/action fingerprint domains remain v1.
rollback_false_negative.proof: Independent read-back after both create-abort and update-abort returns the exact v2 predecessor fingerprint despite measured DBMOD variance.

capacity_commit_gap.finding: With a 32-object bounded extractor, creating object 33 could otherwise commit successfully and make the post-commit semantic snapshot unreadable.
capacity_commit_gap.resolution: Count the authoritative pre-snapshot and refuse create with SNAPSHOT_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED before opening the write transaction when the next object would exceed capacity.
capacity_commit_gap.proof: Live 32-to-33 boundary test returned SNAPSHOT_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED and preserved both entity count and parent semantic fingerprint.

limitations: N5 mutation is intentionally limited to LINE create/update/delete.
N4/N5 semantic extraction remains bounded to active current space plus referenced block definitions/content and MaxSnapshotEntities=32.
R1 compensation, R2 checkpoint restore, post-commit mismatch recovery and two-phase commit integrity remain N7/later work.
N6 semantic delta, allowed-effects and append-only state-chain orchestration are not claimed by this evidence.
The staged native bridge remains internal; COM/ezdxf remains the supported public migration baseline.
decision: N5 CLOSED / LIVE PASS for the bounded typed LINE mutation surface. Composite parent binding, persistent PID targeting, semantic document fingerprint v2, verified R0 abort rollback, COM parity and pre-write snapshot-capacity protection are accepted. N6 may now begin; N7 must remain unopened.
